textures.name: sea
textures.prompt:
Satellite photograph from very high altitude of the deep open Caribbean
Sea: dark navy-blue water with a faint, fine, even texture of distant
swell lines and a very few tiny scattered whitecaps, a slight variation
of tone, no glare, no land, no clouds, nothing else, filling the whole
image.

textures.name: land
textures.prompt:
Satellite photograph from very high altitude of the hilly interior of a
tropical Caribbean island: dense dark green rainforest covering steep
ridges and winding valleys, lit by a low sun from the upper left so the
relief shows in light and shade, a few lighter green clearings and an
olive-brown dry slope, no rivers, no roads, no buildings, no clouds,
filling the whole image.

textures.name: sand
textures.prompt:
Satellite photograph from high altitude of a pale Caribbean beach: cream
white sand with faint ripples and a few patches of olive coastal scrub,
even light, filling the whole image.

textures.name: town
textures.prompt:
Photograph from above at an angle of a single small 17th-century
Caribbean colonial house with white plastered walls, a red clay tile
roof, a dark door and two small windows, standing alone on a plain flat
light grey ground, nothing else.
